rationale: The message reports concrete observed behaviors/output formats for several conversions, without asking or proposing anything. It functions as a results update delivering findings from testing. It also synthesizes multiple observations into one compact report.

evidence.text: Observed: TOML->JSON compact preserves order; TOML->YAML outputs title: hi, arrays dash lines, nested owner.
JSON->TOML emits title = "hi" nums = [1, 2] blank then [owner]. YAML->HCL emits quoted keys: "a" = 1 blank lines.
Basic YAML booleans only true/false, yes string.
